examples.arabic: تضمن تحضير الطبق خطوات عديدة وشعرنا بروح الكرم والتكافل الاجتماعي اثناء الطبخ
examples.english: Preparing the dish involved many steps, and we felt the spirit of generosity and social solidarity during cooking
examples.transliteration: Taḍammana taḥḍīru aṭ-ṭabaqi khuṭuwātīn ʿadīdah wa shaʿarnā bi-rūḥi al-karami wa at-takāfuli al-ijtimāʿīyi athnāʾa aṭ-ṭabkh

examples.arabic: كان الدكتور كمال متحمساً لمتابعة الخطوات القادمة، واثقاً بأن هذا اللقاء سيفتح آفاقاً جديدة للبحث والتعاون الدولي.
examples.english: Dr. Kamal was enthusiastic about following up on the next steps, confident that this meeting would open new horizons for research and international cooperation.
examples.transliteration: Kana al-duktur Kamal mutahammasan li-mutaba'at al-khutuwati al-qadimah, wathiqan bi'anna hadha al-liqa'a sayaftahu afaqan jadidatan lil-bahthi wal-ta'awuni al-dawliyyi.
examples.storyTitle: Greetings and a Meeting in the Realm of Knowledge
